crossing_specificity: The source uses arbitrary braids and words, so it fixes no crossing sequence or endpoint permutation. Use labeled braid blocks and show only the stated generator support and algebraic transformations; do not invent crossings or permutation data.

standard_inclusion.convention: The old braid is expressed at the first n target basepoints; its letters have indices i<n and fix the rightmost target point. Do not depict old parametrized strands as literally unchanged between Q^(n) and Q^(n+1).

conjugation.formula: beta -> gamma beta gamma^(-1) in B_n
conjugation.time_convention: The rightmost factor is traversed first. Any time-oriented schematic of gamma beta gamma^(-1) must respect that order.

stabilization.side_and_position: Adds a strand on the right; sigma_n^(+/-1) is in the fixed right-factor position and fixes the first n-1 target points.
stabilization.inverse_direction: Destabilization goes from B_(n+1) to B_n.

sequence: If beta=uv, conjugating beta by v gives v beta v^(-1)=vu.
Conjugate this braid by v^(-1): v^(-1)[(vu) sigma_n^(+/-1)]v=u sigma_n^(+/-1)v.
factor_insertion.interpretation: The inserted word u sigma_n^(+/-1)v is Markov-equivalent to beta sigma_n^(+/-1) by the displayed sequence. Do not label arbitrary factor insertion as cyclic conjugacy: cyclic conjugation moves a factor past the whole word.
